I'll submit the patch now.
I have successfully resolved the issue.

The `make_classifier()` function in `topicmodel/factory.py` was failing with a `TypeError` because it was passing the `multi_class` argument to `LogisticRegression`, which is no longer supported in the upgraded version of scikit-learn. I removed the `multi_class="multinomial"` argument, as `LogisticRegression` now handles multinomial classification automatically (defaulting to `multi_class='auto'`) when using the `lbfgs` solver. I verified the fix with a reproduction script and a verification script ensuring that the classifier still performs multinomial classification and returns probabilities that sum to 1.
